plan.title: School Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Enrolment trends, infrastructure gaps, and gender parity across blocks

panels.title: Schools with Functional Girls' Toilets
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Schools with Electricity
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "school_infrastructure" WHERE "Electricity" = 'Yes'

panels.title: Enrolment Trend by Gender
panels.sql: SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2022") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2023") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Girls' AS gender, SUM("Girls 2024") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2022") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2023") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" UNION ALL SELECT 'Boys' AS gender, SUM("Boys 2024") AS total FROM "school_enrolment_by_year"

panels.title: Infrastructure Gaps by Block
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", COUNT(*) AS total_schools, SUM(CASE WHEN "Toilets functional (girls)" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_toilets, SUM(CASE WHEN "Electricity" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_electricity, SUM(CASE WHEN "Drinking water" = 'No' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_water FROM "school_infrastructure" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Enrolment by Block and Year
panels.sql: SELECT "Block", SUM("Girls 2022") AS girls_2022, SUM("Girls 2023") AS girls_2023, SUM("Girls 2024") AS girls_2024, SUM("Boys 2022") AS boys_2022, SUM("Boys 2023") AS boys_2023, SUM("Boys 2024") AS boys_2024 FROM "school_enrolment_by_year" GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: In 2024, total girls enrolment stood at {{p1}} and boys at {{p2}}. Infrastructure remains a challenge: only {{p3}} schools have functional toilets for girls, and {{p4}} have electricity. The line chart shows the enrolment trajectory over the last three years, highlighting gender disparities. The bar chart breaks down infrastructure gaps by block, showing where interventions are most needed. The table provides a detailed view of enrolment figures per block.
